title: Assiniboine Dental Group
description: Assiniboine Dental Group is a private dental practice in Winnipeg, Manitoba, operating as a "trustee." It is required to securely store patients' personal health information in accordance with the province's Personal Health Information Protection Act (PHIA). However, due to negligence in security, dental records and payment information (patient names, contact information, treatment history, and insurance/financial transaction information) were compromised and are being offered to your attention.
